' diagram-id: DOM-01
' classification: TARGET
' Authority: ADR-030–036/041/042 + yêu cầu PO 2026-10-12 class-design-completion.
' Model logical design; không schema/SQL/FK/API/implementation.
' Assignment là lượt giao; giữ prior episode, at most 1 active per content target.
' AssessmentBlueprintVersion/Item immutable sau publish/use; gradingData chỉ server.
' Plan/Progress dẫn xuất; không default persisted; score != completion/proficiency.
' Course/Unit visibility derived; không copy content lifecycle hoặc fixed English counts.
title Sơ đồ lớp thiết kế miền Lingora
hide circle
hide empty methods
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
skinparam nodesep 85
skinparam ranksep 130
skinparam defaultFontSize 16
skinparam linetype spline
skinparam minClassWidth 360
skinparam packageStyle rectangle
left to right direction

package "Identity / Learner" {
 class User {
 id: Identifier
 email: String
 role: Admin | Teacher | Learner
 status: AccountStatus
 }

 class Profile {
 displayName: String
 locale: String
 nativeLanguage: Reference[0..1]
 timezone: TimeZone
 streak: Integer
 }

 class LearningContext {
 id: Identifier
 status: ACTIVE | PAUSED
 purpose: LearningPurpose
 studyFocus: StudyFocus = BALANCED
 studyPreferences: Reference[0..1]
 startingPoint: Level
 startingPointSource: String
 selfReportedLevel: Reference[0..1]
 /workingLevel: Level
 assessmentAttempts: Reference[*]
 }

 enum StudyFocus {
 BALANCED
 VOCABULARY
 GRAMMAR
 READING
 LISTENING
 }

 class LessonAttempt {
 id: Identifier
 completed: Boolean
 performance: Percentage[0..1]
 completedAt: DateTime[0..1]
 contributionSum: Number
 responseCount: Integer
 responses: Reference[*]
 }

}

package "Curriculum / Content" {
 class Language {
 code: String
 name: String
 }

 class ProficiencyFramework {
 name: String
 version: String
 }

 class Level {
 label: String
 }

 class Course {
 id: Identifier
 title: String
 curriculumGate: Reference
 }

 class Unit {
 id: Identifier
 code: String
 title: String
 orderIndex: Integer
 }

 class Lesson {
 id: Identifier
 title: String
 orderIndex: Integer
 required: Boolean
 availability: CurriculumAvailability
 topicRefs: Reference[*]
 skillRefs: Reference[*]
 purposeTags: LearningPurpose[*]
 }

 class Vocabulary {
 id: Identifier
 term: String
 definition: String
 pronunciation: String[0..1]
 partOfSpeech: String[0..1]
 example: String[0..1]
 }

}

package "Authoring / Governance" {
 class Exercise {
 id: Identifier
 orderIndex: Integer
 type: ExerciseType
 core: Boolean
 practiceSkillRefs: Reference[*]
 knowledgeArea: String
 prompt: String
 options: String[*]
 gradingData: Reference {server-only}
 mediaRefs: Reference[*]
 }

 class Assignment {
 id: Identifier
 assignedAt: DateTime
 endedAt: DateTime[0..1]
 /active: Boolean
 requirements: String
 scope: String
 checklist: String[*]
 previousAssignment: Reference[0..1]
 }

 class ContentRevision {
 id: Identifier
 revisionNumber: Integer
 status: ContentStatus
 author: Reference
 createdAt: DateTime
 previousRevision: Reference[0..1]
 changeSummary: String[0..1]
 assignment: Assignment
 learnerContent: Reference
 mediaRefs: Reference[*]
 vocabularyMemberships: Reference[*]
 submissionReviewHistory: Reference[*]
 }

 class SecurityAuditEvent {
 id: Identifier
 action: String
 targetType: String
 targetId: Identifier
 targetVersion: Reference[0..1]
 serverTime: DateTime
 outcome: String
 reason: String[0..1]
 }

}

package "Assessment" {
 class AssessmentBlueprint {
 id: Identifier
 purpose: Placement | LevelUp
 language: Reference
 framework: Reference
 levelScope: Reference[0..1]
 nextLevelScope: Reference[0..1]
 coverage: Reference[*]
 itemRequirements: Reference[*]
 curriculumScope: Course
 configuredBy: User {Admin}
 }

 class AssessmentBlueprintVersion {
 id: Identifier
 versionNumber: Integer
 status: ContentStatus
 purposeSnapshot: Placement | LevelUp
 languageSnapshot: Reference
 frameworkSnapshot: Reference
 levelScopeSnapshot: Reference[0..1]
 nextLevelSnapshot: Reference[0..1]
 topicCoverageSnapshot: Reference[*]
 skillCoverageSnapshot: Reference[*]
 curriculumCoverageSnapshot: Reference
 itemRequirementsSnapshot: Reference[*]
 itemCount: Integer
 timeLimitMinutes: Integer[0..1]
 passThreshold: Percentage[0..1]
 resultPolicySnapshot: Reference
 gradingPolicySnapshot: Reference {server-only}
 publishedAt: DateTime[0..1]
 /immutable: Boolean
 submissionReviewHistory: Reference[*]
 }

 class AssessmentResult {
 id: Identifier
 purpose: Placement | LevelUp
 assessmentType: Reference
 deliveryMode: Reference
 score: Percentage
 outcome: String[0..1]
 recommendation: Level[0..1]
 completedAt: DateTime
 provenance: Reference
 }

 class AssessmentItem {
 id: Identifier
 type: ExerciseType
 prompt: String
 options: String[*]
 topicSkillRefs: Reference[*]
 levelScope: Reference[0..1]
 gradingData: Reference {server-only}
 mediaRefs: Reference[*]
 authoring: Reference
 }

}

package "Progress / SRS" {
 class LearningPlan <<derived>> {
 orderedLessons: Lesson[*]
 }

 class Progress <<derived>> {
 /completedRequiredLessons: Integer
 /eligibleRequiredLessons: Integer
 /completionRatio: Number[0..1]
 }

 class SrsCard {
 id: Identifier
 stage: Integer
 dueAt: DateTime
 enrollmentSource: String
 reviewHistory: Reference[*]
 }

}

User "1" *-- "1" Profile
User "1" -- "0..*" LearningContext : Learner sở hữu
LearningContext "1" -- "0..1" LearningPlan : dẫn xuất
LearningContext "1" -- "0..*" Progress : tiến độ
Language "1" -- "0..*" Course : chương trình
ProficiencyFramework "1" -- "1..*" Level : định nghĩa
Course "1" *-- "0..*" Unit : các nhóm bài
Unit "1" *-- "0..*" Lesson : các bài học
Lesson "0..*" -- "0..*" Vocabulary : nội dung từ
LearningContext "1" -- "0..*" LessonAttempt : lượt học
LessonAttempt "0..*" -- "1" Lesson : bài đã học
User "1" -- "0..*" SrsCard : Learner ghi nhớ
SrsCard "0..*" -- "1" Vocabulary : từ được ôn
AssessmentBlueprint "1" -- "0..*" AssessmentBlueprintVersion : các snapshot
AssessmentBlueprintVersion "1" -- "0..*" AssessmentResult : bằng chứng
LearningContext "1" -- "0..*" AssessmentResult : kết quả
Assignment "0..*" -- "1" User : Teacher được giao
Assignment "0..*" -- "1" Lesson : gói nội dung
Lesson "1" *-- "0..*" ContentRevision : các bản sửa
ContentRevision "1" *-- "0..*" Exercise : bài tập
AssessmentBlueprintVersion "1" *-- "0..*" AssessmentItem : item snapshots
User "1" -- "0..*" SecurityAuditEvent : thao tác
LearningContext "0..*" -- "1" Language : ngôn ngữ học
Unit "0..*" -- "1" Level : cấp nội dung
User "1" -- "0..*" Assignment : Admin giao việc
Vocabulary "0..*" -- "1" Language : ngôn ngữ từ
Progress "0..*" -- "1" Level : phạm vi cấp
LessonAttempt "0..*" -- "1" ContentRevision : bản đã học

' Bounded references and relationship constraints: class-review-2026-10-16.md.
' assessmentAttempts pins Context+Version before any Result; no persistence/resume assumed.
' Core/optional vocabularyMemberships belong to the completed ContentRevision.
' authoring/assignment and submissionReviewHistory retain Teacher attribution and feedback.
' Composition never means cascade deletion of referenced learning evidence.
' Supplementary SRS/focus practice never enters pinned assessments or core performance.
' Version/Revision draft có thể 0 items; publish cần readiness theo configuration.
' User→Context 0..* gồm cả lịch sử PAUSED; tối đa 2 ACTIVE là rule, không tổng số rows.
' Không Enrollment, generic workflow/versioning/item pool hoặc CRUD methods.
@enduml
"}
